The painting team the Northern Beaches actually keeps calling back

Twenty plus years. Thirty-nine suburbs. One licensed crew that turns up when we say we will. Sydney Paintmasters has spent two decades painting homes and businesses between the Manly coast and the Pittwater foreshore, and we know what this stretch of Sydney does to paint.

Beachfront render blisters. Headland timber splits. Bushland-edge fascias grow mould in the shade. A repaint here is not just colour, it is protection, and the prep is where most of the work lives. We wash, we sand, we fill, we prime, and only then do we paint. Skip that and the job fails inside two winters.

Everything is quoted fixed price before we lift a brush, with no call-out fee to have us come and look. You get a clear scope, a real start date, and a crew that cleans up at the end of every day. That is the whole pitch. No surprises.

props.label: Specialties
props.html:
Uncontested on the Beaches

Coastal painting most crews get wrong

The Northern Beaches is exposed Pacific coast, high headlands and humid bushland pockets. Standard suburban painting does not hold here. This is the work we have built our name on.

01

Salt-air and coastal exterior systems

Sea spray, wind-driven moisture and brutal UV strip weak coatings off beachfront and headland homes within a couple of seasons. We spec durable, flexible exterior systems built for the marine zone, so your render, weatherboard and metal stay sealed and looking sharp far longer.

02

Weatherboard and timber restoration

Older beach cottages, high-set homes and architect-designed timber builds need patience, not just paint. We strip back failed coatings, treat and protect the timber, repair what has moved, and repaint so the grain and the joinery come back to life.

03

Access on steep and high-set sites

So many homes here cling to a slope or stack up three storeys over the water. Tricky facades, high walls and awkward balconies are normal for us. We bring the right access gear and the safety systems to paint them properly, not just the reachable bits.

props.label: Faq
props.html:
Straight Answers

Northern Beaches painting FAQs

Materials, brands, guarantees and pricing, answered plainly. If your question is not here, just ring us.

What paint brands do you use on Northern Beaches homes?
We use premium trade-grade paints matched to the surface and the exposure, so a salt-blasted headland facade gets a tougher exterior system than a sheltered interior wall. We work with recognised trade brands like Dulux, Taubmans and Wattyl, and spec to your preferred supplier where you have one.
Do you offer a workmanship guarantee?
Yes, we stand behind our work. We put the guarantee in writing with your quote so you know exactly what is covered and for how long before any work starts.
How much does a painter cost on the Northern Beaches?
Every job is priced on the actual scope: surface condition, prep required, height and access, and the coating system. We give you a free, fixed-price written quote with no call-out fee, so you know the full price before any work starts. Call 0423 019 087 for a quote.
Are your painters licensed and insured?
Yes. We hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and we are fully insured. We are happy to show both before you book. Painting in NSW over the licensing threshold legally requires a licence, so it is worth checking any painter you consider.
What is the best exterior paint for salt air and coastal conditions?
On the coast you want a flexible, UV-stable exterior system with strong adhesion and mould resistance, applied over thorough surface prep. The prep matters as much as the product. We select the coating to suit your surface, whether that is render, weatherboard, fibro or metal, and the level of salt exposure at your address.
Do you charge a call-out fee to quote?
No call-out fee. We come out, look at the job, and give you a free fixed-price quote. You are under no obligation to proceed.
How long does it take to repaint a typical Northern Beaches house?
It depends on size, surface condition and weather, since coastal exterior work needs dry conditions between coats. A single interior room is quick. A full exterior repaint of a large home takes longer because the prep is extensive. We give you a realistic timeframe with your quote, not a guess on the phone.
Do you paint heritage and weatherboard homes?
Yes, timber and heritage work is a core part of what we do here. Older cottages and weatherboard homes need careful stripping, timber treatment and the right protective coatings. In heritage-listed areas such as parts of Palm Beach, colour and material choices can be controlled, so we work with what your property is allowed.
Can you handle strata and commercial painting?
Yes. We paint common property for unit blocks and townhouse complexes, plus shopfronts, offices and fit-outs. We work to committee and business timelines, and we can schedule after hours or weekends to limit disruption.
Do you do roof painting and pool painting?
Both. Roof coating for Colourbond and tile, always with a proper clean and prime first. Pool painting on concrete pools with specialist coatings and correct surface preparation so the finish bonds and lasts.
What preparation do you do before painting exterior timber?
We wash the surface, scrape and sand back any failed or flaking coating, treat and fill where the timber needs it, spot-prime bare areas, then apply the full system. On the coast, cutting corners on prep is the number one reason a repaint fails early, so we do not.
Do you offer epoxy flooring?
Yes, we apply hard-wearing epoxy floor coatings for garages, workshops and commercial spaces. The floor is ground or etched and prepped first so the epoxy keys in properly and does not lift under traffic.
Which suburbs on the Northern Beaches do you cover?
All of it. That includes Allambie Heights, Avalon Beach, Balgowlah, Bayview, Beacon Hill, Belrose, Bilgola Beach, Brookvale, Church Point, Clareville, Clontarf, Collaroy, Cromer, Curl Curl, Davidson, Dee Why, Duffys Forest, Elanora Heights, Fairlight, Forestville, Frenchs Forest, Freshwater, Ingleside, Killarney Heights, Manly, Manly Vale, Mona Vale, Narrabeen, Narraweena, Newport, Oxford Falls, Palm Beach, Queenscliff, Scotland Island, Seaforth, Terrey Hills, Warriewood, Whale Beach and Wheeler Heights.
How do I get a fixed-price quote?
Call 0423 019 087 or fill in the quote form on this page with your suburb and what you need painted. We book a look at the job, then send a written fixed price. Simple.

props.label: Suburbs
props.html:
39 Suburbs, Coast to Bushland

Painter coverage across the Northern Beaches

From salt-blasted headlands to shaded bushland fascias, the housing stock changes street by street here. So does the paint job. Here is how we approach each pocket of the region.

Beaches & Pittwater

Mona Vale

2103

A busy town-centre suburb wrapped around a working beach, with a real mix of post-war brick homes, newer duplexes and a commercial strip. That mix means we swing from full residential repaints to shopfront and mixed-use work in the same week. Salt reaches well back from the sand here, so exterior prep gets the coastal treatment. See our services or call us.

Warriewood

2102

Newer estate homes fill the Warriewood valley, alongside beachside houses catching the weather straight off the water. Rendered facades and modern cladding dominate, and both want a flexible exterior system that moves with the building. We prep hard and coat for the sea air. Request a quote.

Narrabeen

2101

Beach and lagoon on two sides means moisture from every direction. Homes here run from older fibro and brick beach houses to renovated family homes near the lakes. Mould-resistant systems and thorough exterior prep are the difference between a five-year finish and a two-year one. Our painting services.

Collaroy

2097

Beachfront and near-beachfront homes take the full brunt of salt spray and coastal wind along this stretch. The dominant stock is a blend of older beach houses and apartment blocks close to the sand. Exterior coatings here need to be tough, and the prep needs to be honest. Get a fixed price.

Elanora Heights

2101

Raised family homes sit up above Narrabeen lagoon, many with big exposed eaves and timber detailing catching wind and afternoon sun. Access and height come into play on the steeper blocks. We bring the gear to paint the whole facade, not just the easy reach. What we paint.

Bayview

2104

Waterfront homes and a marina precinct define Bayview, with larger residences fronting Pittwater. Timber, render and metal all feature, and all cop moisture off the water. These are properties where careful prep and premium exterior systems earn their keep. Ask for a quote or phone 0423 019 087.

Avalon Beach

2107

Avalon has a strong beach-village character, with a walkable core and a housing mix from original cottages to relaxed coastal homes on the Pittwater side. Timber restoration and salt-ready exterior work are common calls here. It sits next to the smaller Clareville pocket, which we also cover. See services.

Manly & Harbourside

Manly

2095

Manly packs a lot into a small footprint: the Corso commercial strip, a heritage core near the beach, and ocean-front homes taking weather off the open Pacific. The stock runs from Federation and heritage buildings to modern apartments. That means shopfront and strata work sitting right alongside detailed residential repaints. Salt exposure here is serious, so exterior systems are chosen to match. Get a quote.

Freshwater

2096

A tight beach-village community with a recognisable surf identity, Freshwater mixes older brick and fibro beach homes with renovated family houses stepping up the hill. Coastal exposure is high near the beach and eases back up the slope, so we tailor the exterior spec to each block. Our services.

Balgowlah

2093

Balgowlah leans older, with established brick homes and a heritage streetscape through parts of the suburb. Demand here has been climbing. These homes often want careful preparation of aged surfaces and a finish that respects the character of the street. Request a fixed-price quote.

Seaforth

2092

Harbourside homes on leafy, sloping streets, with a good number of older houses and heritage touches. Many blocks fall away toward the water, so access and up-high exterior work come up often. We paint the full house, awkward angles included. What we do.

Fairlight, Manly Vale & Clontarf

2093 / 2094

These established harbourside suburbs sit right beside Manly, sharing older weatherboard and brick housing stock and heritage overlaps through several streets. Weatherboard restoration and heritage-sympathetic repaints are the bread and butter here, along with the usual interior refreshes. We cover all three. Get a quote or call 0423 019 087.

Dee Why & Central Beaches

Dee Why

2099

The busy heart of the central Beaches. Dee Why runs from a dense mixed-use town centre and beachfront apartment blocks to established residential streets behind. That gives us plenty of strata and commercial repaints alongside family homes. Beachfront blocks get the salt-ready exterior treatment. Ask for a quote.

Narraweena

2099

A quieter residential pocket of solid post-war brick homes on rising streets. The stock is consistent, which makes for clean, straightforward exterior and interior repaints. Good honest houses that come up beautifully with proper prep and a quality coat. See services.

Cromer

2099

Family homes across the flats and a light-industrial edge give Cromer a bit of everything, residential repaints one street and workshop or commercial coatings the next. We handle both, including epoxy flooring for the industrial side. Get a fixed price.

Brookvale, Beacon Hill, Curl Curl, Queenscliff & Wheeler Heights

2096 / 2097 / 2099 / 2100

A broad mix around the Dee Why centre. Brookvale brings commercial and light-industrial premises (think Warringah Mall and the trade pocket), while Curl Curl and Queenscliff bring beachside homes taking weather off the sand, and Beacon Hill and Wheeler Heights bring high-set brick family homes. So we cover shopfront and strata work through to salt-exposed exteriors across these five. Our services.

Forest & Bushland Belt

Frenchs Forest

2086

Established family homes and the hospital precinct surrounds, set against bushland that keeps parts of the suburb shaded and damp. That shade breeds mould on fascias and eaves, so mould-resistant prep and coatings matter more here than the beach suburbs. Request a quote.

Forestville

2087

Mid-century and later family homes on leafy streets. The dominant stock takes well to a full exterior refresh, and the bushland setting means we pay attention to the shaded, moisture-prone elevations that others skip. What we paint.

Belrose, Davidson, Killarney Heights & Allambie Heights

2085 / 2087 / 2100

Bushland-fringe suburbs backing onto Garigal National Park, dominated by solid brick and timber family homes. Living against the bush means damp, shade and leaf litter working on the exteriors, so weather exposure and mould control drive the prep. We repaint these homes to hold up in the conditions. We cover all four. Get a quote or phone us.

Terrey Hills, Ingleside & Church Point

2084 / 2101 / 2105

The large-lot rural fringe, plus the Pittwater gateway at Church Point. Acreage homes here come with big exterior areas, outbuildings, sheds and long runs of fencing and eaves. More surface, more access, more prep, and we quote it all up front on a fixed price. See what we cover.

Prefer a dedicated page for your suburb? Our in-depth Palm Beach painter and Newport painter guides go deeper on those areas.

data.name: Sydney Paintmasters
data.description: Licensed painting business working across the whole Northern Beaches, from Manly up to Palm Beach and out to the Frenchs Forest bushland belt. Interior and exterior house painting, roof, strata, commercial, epoxy flooring and pool painting.

mainEntity.name: What paint brands do you use on Northern Beaches homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: We use premium trade-grade paints matched to the surface and the exposure, so a salt-blasted headland facade gets a tougher exterior system than a sheltered interior wall. We work with recognised trade brands like Dulux, Taubmans and Wattyl, and spec to your preferred supplier where you have one.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer a workmanship guarantee?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we stand behind our work. We put the guarantee in writing with your quote so you know exactly what is covered and for how long before any work starts.

mainEntity.name: How much does a painter cost on the Northern Beaches?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every job is priced on the actual scope: surface condition, prep required, height and access, and the coating system. We give you a free, fixed-price written quote with no call-out fee, so you know the full price before any work starts. Call 0423 019 087 for a quote.

mainEntity.name: Are your painters licensed and insured?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and we are fully insured. We are happy to show both before you book. Painting in NSW over the licensing threshold legally requires a licence, so it is worth checking any painter you consider.

mainEntity.name: What is the best exterior paint for salt air and coastal conditions?

acceptedAnswer.text: On the coast you want a flexible, UV-stable exterior system with strong adhesion and mould resistance, applied over thorough surface prep. The prep matters as much as the product. We select the coating to suit your surface, whether that is render, weatherboard, fibro or metal, and the level of salt exposure at your address.

mainEntity.name: Do you charge a call-out fee to quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: No call-out fee. We come out, look at the job, and give you a free fixed-price quote. You are under no obligation to proceed.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repaint a typical Northern Beaches house?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on size, surface condition and weather, since coastal exterior work needs dry conditions between coats. A single interior room is quick. A full exterior repaint of a large home takes longer because the prep is extensive. We give you a realistic timeframe with your quote, not a guess on the phone.

mainEntity.name: Do you paint heritage and weatherboard homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, timber and heritage work is a core part of what we do here. Older cottages and weatherboard homes need careful stripping, timber treatment and the right protective coatings. In heritage-listed areas such as parts of Palm Beach, colour and material choices can be controlled, so we work with what your property is allowed.

mainEntity.name: Can you handle strata and commercial painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We paint common property for unit blocks and townhouse complexes, plus shopfronts, offices and fit-outs. We work to committee and business timelines, and we can schedule after hours or weekends to limit disruption.

mainEntity.name: Do you do roof painting and pool painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both. Roof coating for Colourbond and tile, always with a proper clean and prime first. Pool painting on concrete pools with specialist coatings and correct surface preparation so the finish bonds and lasts.

mainEntity.name: What preparation do you do before painting exterior timber?

acceptedAnswer.text: We wash the surface, scrape and sand back any failed or flaking coating, treat and fill where the timber needs it, spot-prime bare areas, then apply the full system. On the coast, cutting corners on prep is the number one reason a repaint fails early, so we do not.

Yes, we apply hard-wearing epoxy floor coatings for garages, workshops and commercial spaces. The floor is ground or etched and prepped first so the epoxy keys in properly and does not lift under traffic.

mainEntity.name: Which suburbs on the Northern Beaches do you cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: All of it. That includes Allambie Heights, Avalon Beach, Balgowlah, Bayview, Beacon Hill, Belrose, Bilgola Beach, Brookvale, Church Point, Clareville, Clontarf, Collaroy, Cromer, Curl Curl, Davidson, Dee Why, Duffys Forest, Elanora Heights, Fairlight, Forestville, Frenchs Forest, Freshwater, Ingleside, Killarney Heights, Manly, Manly Vale, Mona Vale, Narrabeen, Narraweena, Newport, Oxford Falls, Palm Beach, Queenscliff, Scotland Island, Seaforth, Terrey Hills, Warriewood, Whale Beach and Wheeler Heights.

mainEntity.name: How do I get a fixed-price quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: Call 0423 019 087 or fill in the quote form on this page with your suburb and what you need painted. We book a look at the job, then send a written fixed price. Simple.
